case.title: $40k upgrade above budget with source-code access

decision.recommendation: The request for CodeMate Enterprise Upgrade exceeds the available department budget and overlaps with an existing approved CodeMate subscription. I recommend routing this for budget exception review and verifying if the existing 120-seat license can be upgraded or reconfigured to meet the new requirements.

evidence.finding: Engineering department has a $14,000 budget shortfall for this request ($40,000 requested vs $26,000 available).
An existing CodeMate subscription (SW008) is already approved for Engineering with 120 licensed seats.
Request requires Department Head, Procurement, Finance, CFO, and Security approvals due to cost and data access level.
Vendor CodeMate is approved with current security and legal status.
Approval tier > $25,000: $40,000.00 is above $25,000 -> minimum approvals Department Head, Finance, CFO, Procurement
Vendor-risk service: status 'approved', last review 2026-08-20, risk medium, personal data=False, outside region=False; registry: 'Approved' (2026-08-20), new vendor=False, legal terms 'Approved'
Finance review required: Budget exception: $40,000 requested vs $26,000 available (shortfall $14,000)
Security review required: Data access level 'source_code' (source code access)
Security review required: Integration 'Git repositories' (source-code repository integration)
Existing approved software overlaps: CodeMate (Developer AI, 120 seats, scope Engineering)

decision.next_step: Route to Finance for budget exception review and consult with the Engineering manager to determine if the existing CodeMate license can be upgraded instead of purchasing a new enterprise tier.
